top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
attempts.response:
WITH
  baseline AS (
    SELECT
      "Child ID",
      "Child Name",
      "Sit Ups" AS baseline_sit_ups
    FROM sportathon_baseline
  ),
  endline AS (
    SELECT
      "Child ID",
      "Sit Ups" AS endline_sit_ups
    FROM sportathon_endline
  )
SELECT
  e."Child Name",
  (e.endline_sit_ups - b.baseline_sit_ups) AS improvement
FROM endline e
JOIN baseline b ON e."Child ID" = b."Child ID"
ORDER BY improvement DESC
LIMIT 5;
